properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Functions: HTTPS Only Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Function Apps that do not enforce HTTPS-only access. FedRAMP High requires transmission confidentiality (SC-8). All client-to-function communication must be encrypted via HTTPS — HTTP access is prohibited to prevent cleartext data exposure including function keys and payloads.

metadata.description: Deny: Block non-HTTPS Function Apps. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
